| Research release | [39045919547](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/PermanssonLean/actions/runs/39045919547) | 29 tests, 44 repaired-hash guard controls, 27 archive entries and 340 protected canonical blobs PASS |

Fresh R C10 publisher artifact:12106535829, SHA256 `75d61c01020f63d7f9555f10f32de9d63a09c0107536463ae549cdb85ebe9fc8`. This remains the original constructed six-state C10 query, not an X1 numeric certificate.

Delivered kit ZIP SHA256:`4db31db5b805ad2f455f27e5a2e013cd13ea257984e174f6453af8f8db5b1f6c`.
Manifest SHA256:`6065ec5431430f6804ebabffe636170d8bb349f08cfa817776b05a85bb6fe127`.
Primary PDF SHA256:`408daaddf3ce2c641b441cb05e2f64c739165604905f184117e50a9b9aa7225e`.

R introduces no new Lean theorem. Its [17-claim/61-provider crosswalk](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/PermanssonLean/blob/d8a4ffb5b63eb9359a4c0af9134b4f9a3c529618/release/v0.2.0/output/pdf/theorem-map.json) gives exact declarations, complete assumptions and scientific limits. The kit deliberately pins accepted research source5822cdff; this external receipt supplies R acceptance without a hash cycle. [Milestone source receipts](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/PermanssonLean/blob/d8a4ffb5b63eb9359a4c0af9134b4f9a3c529618/release/v0.2.0/acceptance-evidence.json) and [dependency index](https://github.com/HMarcusWH/PermanssonLean/blob/d8a4ffb5b63eb9359a4c0af9134b4f9a3c529618/docs/V020_IMPLEMENTATION_INDEX.md) retain C69/C70/E1/F1/A3/D2/X1 evidence.

Strict MA2 remains OPEN. A3 coupling-Wasserstein/KR identification, invariant existence and ergodic factorization are not inferred. D2 is the proved initialized finite reach-and-stay objective, with broader solver obligations open. Both X1 replete Exact-GR claims fail; distinct actual-model occupation laws are proved, while unrestricted discounted-strategy verification, numerical margin reflection and confirmatory/grounding gates remain OPEN. No empirical or substantive-PR promotion is made.

Original v0.1.8 core/paper/provenance/pins/manifests/application schema and historical D0/D1 remain unchanged.
